scope: Read-only audit of the installed GTK2 palette update/reload path in the current Wayland session.

source.behavior: When the selected GTK theme is accepted and GTK2 setup/refresh reports native_reload_required, synchronize calls reload_open_windows(). The notifier uses DISPLAY and sends _GTK_READ_RCFILES to X11 top-level clients; it does not gate on XDG_SESSION_TYPE.

result: The companion service is active in this Wayland session and has both DISPLAY and WAYLAND_DISPLAY. The code path can address the XWayland server through DISPLAY, but this read-only audit does not prove that an actual GTK2 XWayland application received and applied a palette change.
limits: No personal GTK2 application was open; observed GTK2 processes were Codex-owned clients, previews or the internal editor.
No color scheme was changed and no reload event was broadcast.
No window, application content, focus or VM input was touched.
R130 and R451 cover the GTK2 reload/generation paths in their recorded test contexts, not this live Wayland session end to end.
next: Keep I167 focused on GTK2. When a suitable GTK2 application is available, verify scheme-change delivery on this Wayland/XWayland session without reading its content or restarting it. Do not claim live refresh until the application visibly confirms it.
